evidence.note: Downloads the three vendored libraries and verifies their hashes at build time — directly mirroring the SHA256 pin gate.
Systematically checks security headers, full OAuth+PKCE flow, anti-cheat compliance, ETag cache validators, idempotency, and scope enforcement — the knowable verifier surface.
Verifies landing-page seed visibility, seed minimums (CW and media posts), visibility icons, and Post button label — realism and seed-count gates.
Tests pagination, polls, reports/audit, cookie security attributes, and scope/CSRF — including subtle failure modes like cookie handling.
Repeatedly re-runs and re-tests after fixing 500s, marker handling, and avatar/seed issues — closing the loop rather than declaring done.

reasoning: The agent goes well beyond the level-5 'main flows work' bar: it validates against essentially the entire knowable verifier (hash pins, CSP/headers, OAuth+PKCE, scopes, anti-cheat, seed minimums, palette/button-label/visibility-icon realism, durability/idempotency) matching the level-8 anchor, and adds client-shaped checks (ETag cache validators, pagination), subtle-failure probing (cookie attributes, CSRF), and consistent re-verification after each fix — hallmarks of level 10. It falls just short of a clean 10 because the checks appear as ad-hoc Bash/curl invocations rather than a reusable repeatable suite, and some client shapes (error JSON, offline runtime-fetch) aren't explicitly named. Confidence is medium because the condensed log shows targets but not the depth of each observation.
